description: Read the change history of a video, oldest first: every round of changes asked in words, direct edit and caption fix, with who asked, its status and the version it made. For just the versions use list_versions; for a video still being made, get_video_activity. Cost: Free: no credits.
name: get_thread

outputSchema.description: Clypmint get_thread result. Error results carry error; successful requests expose the identifiers and state available for the next step. Signed media stays in private metadata.

title: Read a video’s history
